title: Operation Document (v1)
description: Immutable typed operations document persisted by the agent service document repository (SPEC-039 R-1). Documents are snapshots: digest values are copied verbatim from the durable stores at assembly time, record ids are provenance anchors (never live references), and publishing is a one-way draft->published lifecycle. No model output appears outside the labeled prose section. This schema describes the full document as served by the single-document fetch (the audited read surface); list endpoints return envelope rows that omit digest and prose so full content is only ever retrieved through the audited fetch.

document_type.description: Typed-document discriminator; shift_summary shipped in Phase 1 (SPEC-039 R-3) and incident_report extended it (SPEC-043 R-1). Future types extend this enum without touching the substrate.

state.description: Lifecycle state. Drafts are visible only to the owner; published documents are visible to every documents:read holder (SPEC-039 R-2).

owner_user_id.description: The user who generated the document; the only identity that may edit (publish), delete, or see it while drafted.

published_at.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339) of publishing; null while drafted.

incident_id.description: Covered incident for incident_report documents (SPEC-043 R-2): the report assembles from exactly one incident, server-derived from the creation request; the anchor is provenance, never a live reference. Absent on shift_summary documents.

session_id.description: A covered session; the provenance index is the future entry point for cross-owner review.

coverage.description: owner: full digest tier; foreign: metadata-only tier behind approvals:list (SPEC-039 R-3).

cited_record_ids.description: Record ids copied into the digest (confirmation ids, execution ids); anchors, not live references.

provenance.description: Provenance block listing covered session ids and cited record ids.

digest.description: Type-specific deterministic digest copied verbatim from the durable stores. Never model output. shift_summary: sessions, confirmation decisions, execution receipts, evidence counts, open items; since SPEC-040 R-1 it also carries a deterministic handover section (covered-session counts, decision/execution details for own coverage, counts-only for foreign coverage, open items, and a quiet flag for empty shifts). incident_report (SPEC-043 R-2): four sections — 'incident' (the incident envelope copied verbatim minus the raw triage text, which is replaced by a has_triage_raw presence marker), 'triage' (the validated triage report copied verbatim, or the marker object {'status': 'not_triaged'}), 'dispatches' (connector dispatch outcomes copied verbatim, possibly empty), and 'session' (the incident's linked triage session under the SPEC-039 R-3 two-tier posture: a full session entry when owned, a metadata-only entry when foreign and the requester holds approvals:list, or the 'foreign_denied' / 'missing' / 'unavailable' markers). Digest bounds mirror the incident-service Pydantic models (SPEC-015 contract parity): title ≤200, summary ≤2000, triage evidence ≤20 refs, hypotheses ≤5, next_steps ≤10, skills_cited ≤10.

prose.description: Optional clearly-labeled generated narrative produced from the digest JSON alone (SPEC-039 R-4); null unless prose_status is included.

prose_status.description: Prose layer outcome; a model error or timeout yields failed and a digest-only document.

summary.description: Deterministic counts-only one-liner derived from the digest at creation (SPEC-041 R-4) — for shift_summary the covered-session/decision/execution/open-item counts or the quiet phrasing from the handover section; for incident_report the incident's severity/status, triage presence, and dispatch/session counts (SPEC-043) — never titles, record ids, decision outcomes, or narrative text, so it may appear in envelope-only list rows. Absent on documents created before the field existed for their type.

blurb.description: AI-generated one-line story extracted from the prose reply's SUMMARY marker (v0.23.3). A bounded, digest-anchored paraphrase of the same material a documents:read holder can retrieve whole via the audited fetch, so it rides envelope-only list rows alongside summary; null when prose was not requested, generation failed, or the model skipped the marker.
